gloss: one place; one spot; a single location

definitions.gloss: one place; one spot; one point
definitions.explanation: A single location, spot, or point. Used both for physical places and abstract points (such as a single error in a document or a single spot on the body).

examples.japanese: {間違|まちが}いが{一箇所|いっかしょ}ある。
{荷物|にもつ}は{一箇所|いっかしょ}にまとめてください。
examples.english: Please put all luggage together in one place.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}に{一箇所|いっかしょ}だけ{修正|しゅうせい}が{必要|ひつよう}だったので、すぐに{直|なお}した。
examples.english: There was just one spot in the document that needed correction, so I fixed it right away.

notes:
A counting expression for places, spots, or locations. Written as {一箇所|いっかしょ} or {一|いっ}カ{所|しょ} or {一|いっ}ヶ{所|しょ}. The counter {箇所|かしょ} is used widely for discrete spots, points of interest, or specific locations.

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- {一箇所|いっかしょ}: one place
- {二箇所|にかしょ}: two places
- {三箇所|さんかしょ}: three places
- {数箇所|すうかしょ}: several places
- {何箇所|なんかしょ}: how many places

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一箇所|いっかしょ}にまとめる: to gather in one place
- {一箇所|いっかしょ}に{集|あつ}まる: to assemble in one spot
- {一箇所|いっかしょ}だけ: just one spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一|ひと}つの{場所|ばしょ}: one place — more colloquial
- {一|いっ}か{所|しょ}に{集中|しゅうちゅう}する: to concentrate in one spot — emphasizes consolidation
